name: Trial
overview: The Scriptures reveal that trials involve careful judgment and the seeking of God's guidance, as seen when the Israelitish woman's son who blasphemed the LORD was held in custody until the Lord instructed Moses on the appropriate judgment (Leviticus 24:10-14). This illustrates the seriousness of offenses and the necessity of divine direction in trials. Additionally, John 7:51 emphasizes the principle of hearing and understanding a person’s actions before passing judgment, underscoring the importance of fairness and righteousness in the process of trial.
